import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import pytest

from doorstop.core.tree import Tree
from doorstop.core.document import Document
from doorstop.core.item import Item
from doorstop.core.vcs.mockvcs import WorkingCopy


@pytest.fixture
def temp_dir():
    """Create a temporary directory for a Doorstop project."""
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    yield d
    shutil.rmtree(d)


def _create_documents_and_items(tree: Tree, count: int):
    """Create a single document and add `count` items to it."""
    doc = tree.create_document("doc1")
    for i in range(1, count + 1):
        # Use a simple heading and text
        heading = f"REQ{i:05d}"
        text = f"Requirement {i}"
        tree.add_item(doc, heading, text)
    return doc


def test_U02_4__Decision_Tab__TC_009(temp_dir):
    """Test boundary scenario for scalability with 1000 requirements."""
    # Setup a mock VCS working copy
    wc = WorkingCopy(temp_dir)
    tree = Tree(temp_dir, vcs=wc)
    # Create 1000 items
    _create_documents_and_items(tree, 1000)
    # Verify that the tree reports the correct number of items
    assert len(tree.documents) == 1
    doc = tree.documents[0]
    assert len(doc.items) == 1000
    # Ensure that each item has a UID and level
    for item in doc.items:
        assert isinstance(item.uid, str)
        assert isinstance(item.level, str)


def test_U02_4__Decision_Tab__TC_010(temp_dir):
    """Test boundary scenario for scalability with 5000 requirements."""
    wc = WorkingCopy(temp_dir)
    tree = Tree(temp_dir, vcs=wc)
    _create_documents_and_items(tree, 5000)
    assert len(tree.documents) == 1
    doc = tree.documents[0]
    assert len(doc.items) == 5000
    for item in doc.items:
        assert isinstance(item.uid, str)
        assert isinstance(item.level, str)


def test_U02_4__Decision_Tab__TC_011(temp_dir):
    """Test boundary scenario for scalability with 10000 requirements."""
    wc = WorkingCopy(temp_dir)
    tree = Tree(temp_dir, vcs=wc)
    _create_documents_and_items(tree, 10000)
    assert len(tree.documents) == 1
    doc = tree.documents[0]
    assert len(doc.items) == 10000
    for item in doc.items:
        assert isinstance(item.uid, str)
        assert isinstance(item.level, str)


def test_U02_4__Decision_Tab__TC_012(temp_dir):
    """Test durability of permanent and secure storage."""
    # Create a document with a single item
    wc = WorkingCopy(temp_dir)
    tree = Tree(temp_dir, vcs=wc)
    _create_documents_and_items(tree, 1)
    # Simulate a restart by re‑initialising the tree from the same directory
    tree2 = Tree(temp_dir, vcs=wc)
    # Verify that the item is still present
    assert len(tree2.documents) == 1
    doc2 = tree2.documents[0]
    assert len(doc2.items) == 1
    item = doc2.items[0]
    assert item.uid == "REQ00001"
    assert item.text == "Requirement 1"
